VR Training

Petites Attentions

Makes people want to work in care jobs that are little known or undervalued, such as childcare, by letting them live a moment of the job in VR. In a 360° scene filmed in a real home, the player answers questions about what is happening and hunts for hidden dangers with a flashlight. Runs offline on Meta Quest 2 and 3, and trainers write new scenarios inside the headset, with no new build.

Features

  • 360° video that pauses for multiple-choice questions
  • Flashlight hunt for hidden dangers in each scene
  • Smooth scrubbing through time with the thumbstick
  • In-headset workshop to create and edit scenarios
  • Fully offline on Quest 2 and Quest 3
  • Explanations after a wrong answer, then a retry

Technologies

Unity 6 OpenXR Meta Quest UI Toolkit 360° video
